items.description: The aim of Food Care is to create a healthy service for clients interested to purchase web and mobile applications. The Food Care app offers resources from local dietitians targeted to a local community. The benefits of this app include connection to local restaurants, introduction to prepare healthy recipes, and personalization of a dietary plan.
Personalized healthy recipes in your inbox. Add items that you love to eat like Chinese, apples, or pancakes, and we'll email you a healthy recipe each day to make.
